summary.zh-CN: T1 告警研判员与 T2 事件调查员：告警分诊、实体上下文、证据时间线、调查报告、狩猎计划草案与交班记录；所有处置只作建议。
summary.en: A T1 triage analyst and a T2 investigator: alert triage, entity context, evidence timelines, investigation reports, hunting plan drafts and shift handovers; every response action is a recommendation.

now.zh-CN: 对提供的告警给出真/误/待定判定、严重度、置信度与证据表
now.en: Classify provided alerts as true, false or undetermined with severity, confidence and evidence

now.zh-CN: 建立证据时间线并完成事件调查报告草案
now.en: Build evidence timelines and draft investigation reports

now.zh-CN: 按 ATT&CK 编写假设驱动的狩猎计划与查询草案
now.en: Write ATT&CK-based hypothesis hunting plans and query drafts

needs.zh-CN: 告警原文或导出；持续研判需接入你的 SIEM/EDR
needs.en: Alert text or exports; ongoing triage needs your SIEM/EDR connected

needs.zh-CN: 资产台账、目录信息与响应授权边界
needs.en: Asset inventory, directory data and response authority boundaries

needs.zh-CN: 狩猎需说明遥测覆盖与字段
needs.en: Hunting needs your telemetry coverage and fields

permissions.zh-CN: 只读查询告警、日志、目录与资产
permissions.en: Read-only access to alerts, logs, directory and assets

permissions.zh-CN: 需你确认才会做：关闭或抑制告警、封禁账号、隔离主机、修改规则
permissions.en: Only with your confirmation: closing or suppressing alerts, disabling accounts, isolating hosts or changing rules

conditions.zh-CN: 2026-09-25 已用真实模型验证上传告警的 T1 分诊：给出判定、严重度、置信度、证据缺口与升级建议。
conditions.en: T1 triage of uploaded alerts verified with a real model on 2026-09-25: classification, severity, confidence, evidence gaps and escalation.

conditions.zh-CN: 实时研判与调查需要你自己的 SIEM/EDR 只读连接，本方案不含任何厂商凭据。
conditions.en: Live triage and investigation need your own read-only SIEM/EDR connection; no vendor credentials are included.
